source: Built from benchmark/runs/after-ecb9bbd/raw/B.jsonl (stored extractions, line_items and po_number only) and benchmark/dataset/ground_truth.json: the 19 Company B INVOICE records with final_decision ACCEPT and a po_number. PO lines come from ground-truth lines (description, quantity, unit_price; receipt_required true, no item codes); received = quantity, billed = 0 on every line. expected_signals is the observed result of the clean record (known pairing gaps included), plus the planted fault on the first paired line; split_delivery halves that line's invoice quantity and receipts the same, so it must add nothing. One-off script, not committed.
